name: Handles, Jumpers & Defense
summary: Wake up your handle, hit mid-range jumpers off a hard stop, slide and run on defense, then finish with dribble sprints.

drills.name: Hockey Pull Dribbles
drills.summary: Push the ball out and pull it back low, like a hockey stick.
steps: Get in a low stance with the ball in your right hand.
Push the ball out in front, then pull it back to your hip with one hand.
Keep it below your knee the whole time.
Switch to your left hand after 30 seconds.
Finish by pulling it back and crossing it to the other hand.

drills.name: Elbow Stride-Stop Jumpers
drills.summary: Attack from the wing and stop on balance for an elbow jumper.
steps: Start on the right wing past the three-point line.
Take two hard dribbles to the elbow.
Stop with a quick 1-2 step, inside foot first.
Rise and shoot straight up and land in the same spot.
Rebound, go to the left wing and repeat. Alternate sides.

drills.name: Slide-Run-Slide
drills.summary: Slide, turn and run when you get beat, then sit back in your stance.
steps: Start at the baseline in a low defensive stance.
Slide three steps to your right.
Open your hips and sprint five steps on an angle.
Stop, sit back in your stance and slide three steps the other way.
Zig-zag to half court, jog back and repeat.

drills.name: Dribble Sprint Pyramid
drills.equipment: 1 ball, full court or long driveway
drills.summary: Build up and back down with full-speed dribble sprints.
steps: Speed dribble one length of the court, then rest 15 seconds.
Go two lengths, then rest 15 seconds.
Go three lengths, then rest 20 seconds.
Come back down: two lengths, then one.
Use your right hand going down and your left hand coming back.
